about_the_game:
Hidden Portals: Eternal Balance is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game — a story-rich, point-and-click experience that blends exploration with puzzle-solving. You'll search for cleverly concealed objects in beautifully illustrated scenes and solve a variety of brain-teasing mini-games. It’s a relaxing yet mentally engaging way to immerse yourself in a fantasy world filled with secrets and surprises!

Time is unraveling. Entire moments are vanishing. When Alice Lofton, a skilled manuscript restorer, stumbles upon her father’s desperate attempt to manipulate time and bring back his lost love, she must act fast. Her journey takes her to Luminaria — a magical dimension where reality is fracturing. With the fate of time itself at stake, and guided by an unlikely duo, Alice must stop her father and restore the delicate balance before everything disappears.

Put your perception and logic to the test! Enjoy a wide range of challenges, from immersive hidden object scenes to uniquely crafted mini-games. Each level brings a fresh twist to keep you engaged and thinking creatively.

This Collector's Edition includes:

🕳 Unlock fantasy-themed bonus content, from lore to in-game rewards

🕳 Collect dozens of hidden items and mystical artifacts

🕳 Travel through dreamlike locations: glowing cities, crumbling temples, and ancient ruins

🕳 Solve intricate puzzles and unwind with soothing mini-games

🕳 Earn achievements that reveal hidden layers of the story

🕳 Enjoy a captivating soundtrack, exclusive wallpapers, and more

Join a captivating blend of mystery, magic, and challenge. Step through the portal and lose yourself in a world where every puzzle brings you closer to saving time itself!
